title: CADRE: Stable, Parameter Efficient Adaptation of Medical Vision Language Models with Bounded Forgetting and Prior Drift
abstract: arXiv:2606.23487v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) such as BiomedCLIP generalize broadly, but adapting them to a clinical service is as much a safety problem as an accuracy one. Updating a deployed model for a new imaging modality can fail silently in two ways that harm patients: it can forget modalities it already handled (catastrophic forgetting), and it can drift from its trustworthy pretrained prior toward modality-specific shortcuts. We study parameter-efficient continual adaptation through these two properties rather than leaderboard accuracy, presenting CADRE: a frozen-backbone framework combining low-rank adaptation (LoRA) with an online, self-scaling, similarity-aware elastic weight consolidation term that bounds retained-competence loss, and an anchor-to-prior penalty bounding embedding drift from the frozen prior. Two short guarantees, a bound on total consolidation mass and a scale-invariance property, remove the scale-related sources

translated_title: CADRE：医学视觉语言模型的稳定、参数高效适配，具有有界遗忘与先验漂移控制
translated_abstract: 医学视觉语言模型（VLMs）如BiomedCLIP具有广泛的泛化能力，但将其适配到临床服务既是一个准确性问题，也是一个安全问题。针对新成像模态更新已部署模型时，可能以两种方式无声地失败并伤害患者：它会遗忘已处理的模态（灾难性遗忘），以及它会从可信的预训练先验漂移向特定模态的捷径。我们通过这两个特性而非排行榜准确性来研究参数高效的持续适配，提出CADRE：一个冻结骨干框架，结合低秩适配（LoRA）与在线、自缩放、相似性感知的弹性权重巩固项，以限制保留能力损失，以及一个锚定到先验的惩罚项，以限制从冻结先验的嵌入漂移。两个简短保证——总巩固质量的界和尺度不变性属性——消除了与尺度相关的来源。
tldr: 本文提出CADRE框架，通过结合LoRA与相似性感知的弹性权重巩固及锚定先验惩罚，在参数高效持续适配医学视觉语言模型时，同时保证有界的遗忘和先验漂移，从而提升安全性与稳定性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CADRE, a framework combining LoRA with similarity-aware elastic weight consolidation and anchor-to-prior penalties, to ensure bounded forgetting and prior drift during parameter-efficient continual adaptation of medical vision-language models, enhancing safety and stability.
